personal.title: Senior Software Engineer
personal.bio: Results-oriented Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building performant and scalable applications using React, Redux, Node.js, and TypeScript. Skilled in developing cross-platform solutions, improving UI/UX, and collaborating across Agile teams. Strong advocate of clean code, automated testing, accessibility, and cloud-native deployments.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Architected and delivered microservices and micro-frontend modules serving millions of financial transactions daily.
Led cloud-native deployments on AWS (EC2, S3, IAM) with 99.9 % uptime.
Championed Agile ceremonies — sprint planning, retrospectives, and code reviews across distributed teams.
Integrated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Jenkins) reducing release cycles by 40 %.
Drove WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance audits for customer-facing dashboards using NVDA and axe-core.

experiences.title: Technology Analyst
highlights: Delivered full-stack features on React / Node.js powering internal networking management tools.
Designed RESTful API endpoints and integrated PostgreSQL data layers.
Authored Jest and Cypress test suites achieving 90 %+ code coverage.
Collaborated with cross-functional Agile squads to ship features ahead of release deadlines.

experiences.title: React Front-End Developer
highlights: Built a video-analysis software UI leveraging React Hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo) for real-time rendering.
Developed a custom media player component with keyboard-accessible controls and ARIA live regions.
Optimized bundle size by ~35 % through code-splitting and lazy loading strategies.

experiences.title: Web Developer
highlights: Built a React / Redux SPA for investment portfolio management with real-time data visualizations.
Developed a React Native feedback application deployed to iOS and Android stores.
Integrated Firebase Authentication, Firestore, and Cloud Functions for secure backend operations.
